description: Reconciliation between the census's production paths and the completeness capability map (capabilities.json). Every census production path is either mapped (the capability map owns it and selects a rule family for it) or explicitly declared unmapped with a rationale and an owning issue. Catalog data paths the map selects a family for are recorded separately: they are inputs of the matrix rather than product code, so they are never census production paths. The census validator fails when a mapped declaration stops matching the map or an unmapped declaration silently becomes mapped, so mapping rot is noisy in both directions.

unmapped_production_paths.rationale: 2026-08-21: the engine-level container descriptor lives outside modules/foundry_script/, and the capability map refuses a production path outside that root by construction (is_foundry_script_production_rule, fs_type_completeness_manifest.cpp). Selecting a family for an engine-wide path is a specification change to the selector rather than a mapping this census can make, so the path stays declared and visible instead of silently unowned.

mapped_catalog_paths.rationale: The rule manifest of a family: a change to it can remove or rekey cases, which is exactly the coverage regression the presubmit comparison exists to catch, so it selects its own family.
